instruction: Please enable the screen blank feature and set it to blank after 5 minutes of inactivity.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen blank feature by setting idle-delay from 0 (disabled) to 300 seconds (5 minutes). Verified that gsettings outputs format 'uint32 300\n' for this value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the idle-delay setting using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay', which is the exact state needed to verify screen blank configuration
Expected value 'uint32 300\n' is semantically correct: 300 seconds equals 5 minutes as required by the instruction, and the format matches the actual gsettings output format
Metric 'exact_match' appropriately performs strict string comparison, ensuring the setting is exactly 300 seconds (5 minutes) as instructed
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies both enabling the screen blank feature (changing from 0 to non-zero) and setting the correct time (300 seconds = 5 minutes)
Preconfig correctly sets initial state to 0 (disabled), making the task requirement clear and testable
